entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: Home plane of Vivien Reid, destroyed by Nicol Bolas and now completely dead.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker from Skalla, one of the Smaragdi, who planeswalked to safety with the Arkbow.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who plundered the Nura for their secrets and destroyed Skalla.

entities.name: Smaragdi
entities.description: Forest dwellers, rangers and druids sworn to protect Skalla's forest creatures.

entities.name: Nura
entities.description: An advanced civilization encircling the dwindling woodlands of Skalla.

entities.name: Arkbow
entities.description: Unique artifact made by the Nura and Smaragdi, containing an invocation of every creature that ever lived on Skalla.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas takes an interest in the Nura and their innovations and plunders them for their secrets.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas took an interest in the Nura and their innovations

events.summary: Having drained the Nura, Bolas deems the plane useless and begins to destroy it; the Nura flee to the forest.
events.quote: Bolas decided the plane was useless to him and began to destroy it.

events.summary: The Nura and Smaragdi combine their magic into the Arkbow for a last stand against Bolas.
events.quote: the Nura and Smaragdi combined their collective magic into a unique artifact, the Arkbow

events.summary: As the forest burns and the battle is lost, Vivien instinctively planeswalks to safety with the Arkbow; Skalla dies.
events.quote: Vivien instinctively planeswalked to safety with the Arkbow.

relations.quote: It was destroyed by Nicol Bolas .
the Nura and Smaragdi combined their collective magic into a unique artifact, the Arkbow

relations.note: Divided, with Nura encroaching on the forests, before uniting against Bolas
relations.quote: Skalla was deeply divided between the Smaragdi forest dwellers and the Nura
